class.name: GameInputDevice
class.brief_description: Weak handle to a single GameInput device.
class.description: [GameInputDevice] is a GDScript-facing wrapper around an [code]IGameInputDevice[/code]. It stores only a session-local monotonic device id (a weak handle), so it is cheap to keep around in user code. All instance methods resolve through the [GameInput] singleton; if the device has been disconnected since the wrapper was handed out, every method returns a safe default ([code]false[/code], [code]0[/code], an empty [String], [code]-1.0[/code], an empty [Dictionary]) instead of crashing. Device ids are never recycled within a process, so a stored id remains a stable identity for as long as your game runs. Wrappers are obtained from [method GameInput.get_devices], [method GameInput.get_primary_device], [method GameInput.get_device_by_id], or the [signal GameInput.device_connected] signal. The [enum Button], [enum Axis], and [enum Source] enums describe the input vocabulary used by [GameInputReading] and [GameInputBinding]. [enum Source] is a single combined namespace so editor dropdowns can show one unified list: gamepad buttons are [code]0[/code]–[code]29[/code], axes [code]100[/code]–[code]114[/code], arcade stick buttons [code]200[/code]–[code]213[/code], flight stick buttons [code]300[/code]–[code]313[/code], and racing wheel buttons [code]400[/code]–[code]413[/code]. Keyboards and mice have no [enum Source] values; read them through [GameInputReading] or Godot's own input events. Vibration follows Godot's joypad API: [method start_vibration] takes a weak and a strong magnitude and an optional duration, like [method Input.start_joy_vibration]. Force feedback motors, found on racing wheels and flight sticks, play [GameInputForceFeedbackEffect] objects created with [method create_force_feedback_effect].

method.name: get_device_id
method.description: Returns the session-local monotonic id assigned when this device first connected. The id is never recycled and is the same value reported by [signal GameInput.device_disconnected]. Useful as a stable key in player-to-device dictionaries.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns the human-readable device name reported by GameInput (e.g. "Xbox Wireless Controller"). Falls back to a synthesized [code]"GameInput Device VVVV:PPPP"[/code] string built from vendor and product ids when no display name is available, or to [code]"GameInput Aggregate Device"[/code] for an unnamed aggregate from [method GameInput.create_aggregate_device]. Returns an empty [String] if the device has been disconnected.

method.name: get_kind_mask
method.description: Returns the device's supported-input mask as a bitfield of [enum GameInput.DeviceKind] flags. A single physical device may report several kinds (for example a racing wheel that also reports [constant GameInput.DEVICE_CONTROLLER]). Returns [constant GameInput.DEVICE_UNKNOWN] when the device has been disconnected.

method.name: is_connected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the device is still in the [GameInput] cache. Wrappers stay alive after disconnect, so user code holding a reference can safely call this to gate further work.

method.name: supports_vibration
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the device reports any rumble motors. Use this before calling [method start_vibration] or [method GameInput.set_vibration] to avoid wasted calls on devices that cannot rumble. [method get_supported_rumble_motors] tells which motors exist.

method.name: supports_haptics
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [code]IGameInputDevice::GetHapticInfo()[/code] succeeds and reports at least one haptic location. This is distinct from rumble support exposed by [method supports_vibration]. [method get_haptic_info] returns the details. The addon does not play haptic waveforms, which GameInput sends through an audio endpoint.

method.name: get_device_info
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] describing the device. Returns an empty [Dictionary] when the device is disconnected. Always present: [code]name[/code] ([String]), [code]vendor_id[/code], [code]product_id[/code], [code]revision[/code], [code]device_family[/code] ([enum DeviceFamily]), [code]supported_input_kinds[/code] (the raw [code]GameInputKind[/code] mask), [code]supported_input_mask[/code] ([enum GameInput.DeviceKind] mask), [code]supports_vibration[/code] ([bool]), [code]controller_axis_count[/code], [code]controller_button_count[/code], [code]controller_switch_count[/code], [code]force_feedback_motor_count[/code], [code]status[/code] ([enum DeviceStatus]), [code]app_local_id[/code] and [code]root_app_local_id[/code] (64-character hexadecimal [String]s), [code]container_id[/code] and [code]pnp_path[/code] ([String]s), [code]hardware_version[/code] and [code]firmware_version[/code] ([String]s), [code]usage_page[/code], [code]usage_id[/code], [code]supported_rumble_motors[/code] ([enum RumbleMotor]), [code]supported_system_buttons[/code] ([enum SystemButton]) and [code]is_mock[/code] ([bool]). Present when the device supports the kind: [code]keyboard[/code] ([code]kind[/code] as [enum KeyboardKind], [code]layout[/code], [code]key_count[/code], [code]function_key_count[/code], [code]max_simultaneous_keys[/code], [code]platform_type[/code], [code]platform_subtype[/code]); [code]mouse[/code] ([code]supported_buttons[/code] as [enum MouseButton], [code]sample_rate[/code], [code]has_wheel_x[/code], [code]has_wheel_y[/code]); [code]sensors[/code] ([code]supported_sensors[/code] as [enum SensorKind]); [code]gamepad[/code] ([code]supported_buttons[/code], [code]extra_button_count[/code], [code]extra_axis_count[/code]); [code]arcade_stick[/code] and [code]flight_stick[/code] ([code]extra_button_count[/code], [code]extra_axis_count[/code]); [code]racing_wheel[/code] ([code]has_clutch[/code], [code]has_handbrake[/code], [code]has_pattern_shifter[/code], [code]min_pattern_shifter_gear[/code], [code]max_pattern_shifter_gear[/code], [code]max_wheel_angle[/code] ([float]), [code]extra_button_count[/code], [code]extra_axis_count[/code]); and [code]force_feedback_motors[/code], an [Array] with one [method get_force_feedback_motor_info] [Dictionary] per motor. Values are [int] unless noted, and the [code]has_*[/code] keys are [bool]. Keys are only ever added, so code written against the original keys keeps working.

method.name: button_to_source
method.description: Translates a [enum Button] flag value (a single bit such as [constant BUTTON_A]) into the matching [enum Source] value used by [member GameInputBinding.source]. Returns [constant SRC_BTN_A] for [constant BUTTON_NONE], combined bits and unknown values, as a safe default.

method.name: axis_to_source
method.description: Translates an [enum Axis] index value (such as [constant AXIS_LEFT_X] or [constant AXIS_WHEEL]) into the matching [enum Source] value used by [member GameInputBinding.source]. Returns [constant SRC_AXIS_LEFT_X] for unrecognized inputs as a safe default.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns the device's [enum DeviceStatus] flags as last reported by GameInput, such as [constant STATUS_CONNECTED] and [constant STATUS_HAPTIC_INFO_READY]. Changes are announced by [signal GameInput.device_status_changed]. Returns [constant STATUS_NONE] when the device has been disconnected.

method.name: get_app_local_id
method.description: Returns the device's app-local id as a 64-character hexadecimal [String]. Unlike [method get_device_id], it stays the same across runs of the app and reboots as long as the device connects through the same USB port, so it can key saved per-device settings. Returns an empty [String] when the device has been disconnected.

method.name: get_device_family
method.description: Returns the device's [enum DeviceFamily], such as [constant FAMILY_XBOX_ONE] or [constant FAMILY_HID]. Returns [constant FAMILY_UNKNOWN] when the device has been disconnected.

method.name: get_supported_rumble_motors
method.description: Returns the [enum RumbleMotor] flags of the rumble motors the device has. [method start_vibration] and [method GameInput.set_vibration] ignore values for motors that are missing. Returns [constant RUMBLE_NONE] when the device has no motors or has been disconnected.

method.name: get_supported_system_buttons
method.description: Returns the [enum SystemButton] flags of the system buttons (Guide, Share) the device has.

method.name: get_system_buttons
method.description: Returns the [enum SystemButton] flags held on the device as last reported by [signal GameInput.system_buttons_changed]. Stays [constant SYSTEM_BUTTON_NONE] until GameInput reports a system button, which depends on the platform and the focus policy.

method.name: get_keyboard_layout
method.description: Returns the platform identifier of the keyboard's current layout, as reported when the keyboard connected and updated by [signal GameInput.keyboard_layout_changed]. Returns [code]0[/code] for devices that are not keyboards or have been disconnected.

method.name: get_button_label
method.description: Returns the label GameInput reports for the button behind [param source], an [enum Source] value, as a snake_case name such as [code]"xbox_a"[/code], [code]"letter_a"[/code], [code]"cross"[/code] or [code]"none"[/code]. Use it to pick the button prompt to show. Returns [code]"unknown"[/code] when GameInput reports an unknown label, and an empty [String] when the device has no label field for that source (axes, gamepad buttons other than face, menu, view, D-pad, shoulder, thumbstick, C and Z, or a source for another device kind) or has been disconnected.

method.name: get_haptic_info
method.description: Returns the device's haptic information as a [Dictionary]: [code]ready[/code] ([bool], [code]true[/code] once [constant STATUS_HAPTIC_INFO_READY] is set), [code]supported[/code] ([bool], same as [method supports_haptics]), [code]audio_endpoint_id[/code] ([String], the audio device that plays the haptic waveforms), [code]locations[/code] (a [PackedStringArray] of snake_case names: [code]"grip_left"[/code], [code]"grip_right"[/code], [code]"trigger_left"[/code], [code]"trigger_right"[/code], [code]"none"[/code] or [code]"unknown"[/code]) and [code]location_guids[/code] (the same locations as GUID strings). Devices without haptics report [code]supported[/code] as [code]false[/code] and no locations. Returns an empty [Dictionary] when the device has been disconnected. GameInput plays haptic waveforms through the audio endpoint; this addon reports the information but does not play waveforms.

method.name: start_vibration
method.description: Starts vibrating the device, following [method Input.start_joy_vibration]: [param weak_magnitude] drives the high-frequency (weak) motor and [param strong_magnitude] the low-frequency (strong) motor. [param left_trigger] and [param right_trigger] drive the impulse-trigger motors on devices that have them. Every value is clamped to [code][0.0, 1.0][/code] and values for missing motors are ignored. When [param duration] is greater than [code]0[/code], [method GameInput.poll] stops the vibration once that many seconds have passed. [code]0[/code] (the default) vibrates until [method stop_vibration] or another vibration call. Returns [code]true[/code] when the request was sent, or [code]false[/code] when the device has no rumble motors, has been disconnected, the runtime is not initialized, or GameInput reports a failure.

method.name: stop_vibration
method.description: Stops all rumble on the device, including trigger rumble, and clears any duration. Does not affect force-feedback effects; use [method GameInput.stop_haptics] to silence those too.

method.name: is_vibrating
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while any rumble motor on the device is set above [code]0[/code] by this addon, whether through [method start_vibration] or [method GameInput.set_vibration].

method.name: get_vibration_strength
method.description: Returns the current rumble levels as [code]Vector2(weak, strong)[/code], matching [method Input.get_joy_vibration_strength]. Returns [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] when the device is not vibrating or has been disconnected.

method.name: get_trigger_vibration_strength
method.description: Returns the current impulse-trigger rumble levels as [code]Vector2(left, right)[/code]. Returns [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] when the triggers are not vibrating or the device has been disconnected.

method.name: get_vibration_duration
method.description: Returns the duration, in seconds, passed to the [method start_vibration] call that is playing, matching [method Input.get_joy_vibration_duration]. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for vibrations without a duration and when the device is not vibrating.

method.name: get_vibration_remaining_duration
method.description: Returns how many seconds are left before a timed vibration stops. Returns [code]-1.0[/code] while vibrating without a duration, and [code]0.0[/code] when the device is not vibrating.

method.name: get_force_feedback_motor_count
method.description: Returns the number of force-feedback motors on the device, usually found on racing wheels and flight sticks. Motor indices for the other force-feedback methods run from [code]0[/code] to this value minus one.

method.name: get_force_feedback_motor_info
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] describing motor [param motor_index]: [code]supported_axes[/code] ([enum GameInputForceFeedbackEffect.FeedbackAxis] flags the motor can move along) and [code]supported_effects[/code] (an [Array] of the [enum GameInputForceFeedbackEffect.EffectKind] values it can play). Returns an empty [Dictionary] for an index out of range or a disconnected device.

method.name: is_force_feedback_motor_powered_on
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if force-feedback motor [param motor_index] is powered on. Some wheels power their motor separately; effects on an unpowered motor have no effect. Returns [code]false[/code] for an index out of range or a disconnected device.

method.name: set_force_feedback_motor_gain
method.description: Sets the master gain of force-feedback motor [param motor_index], scaling every effect it plays. [param gain] is clamped to [code][0.0, 1.0][/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] for an index out of range, a disconnected device, or when the runtime is not initialized.

method.name: create_force_feedback_effect
method.description: Creates a force-feedback effect on motor [param motor_index] and returns it, stopped, as a [GameInputForceFeedbackEffect]. [param params] describes the effect and must contain [code]kind[/code], an [enum GameInputForceFeedbackEffect.EffectKind] value the motor supports (see [method get_force_feedback_motor_info]). The other keys are listed in [GameInputForceFeedbackEffect]; keys that are left out keep their defaults. Returns [code]null[/code] with a warning when [param motor_index] is out of range, [param params] is invalid, the motor does not support the effect kind or GameInput refuses to create the effect, and [code]null[/code] when the device has been disconnected.

method.name: scan_code_to_physical_key
method.description: Converts a keyboard scan code, as reported in the [code]scan_code[/code] field of [method GameInputReading.get_key_states], to Godot's physical [enum @GlobalScope.Key] value, the same value [member InputEventKey.physical_keycode] uses. Extended keys use the [code]0xE0xx[/code] form. Returns [code]0[/code] ([constant @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE]) for scan codes without a Godot key.

method.name: virtual_key_to_keycode
method.description: Converts a Windows virtual-key code, as reported in the [code]virtual_key[/code] field of [method GameInputReading.get_key_states], to Godot's [enum @GlobalScope.Key] value for the key label. Accepts [code]0[/code]–[code]255[/code]; returns [code]0[/code] ([constant @GlobalScope.KEY_NONE]) for other values and for virtual keys without a Godot key.

method.name: switch_position_to_vector
method.description: Converts a [enum SwitchPosition] value to a direction [Vector2] in Godot's 2D convention: [constant SWITCH_UP] is [code]Vector2(0, -1)[/code] and [constant SWITCH_RIGHT] is [code]Vector2(1, 0)[/code]. Diagonals are normalized (about [code]0.7071[/code] per axis). [constant SWITCH_CENTER] and unknown values return [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code].
